titleEn: Time Needed to Inform All Employees
title: 通知所有员工所需的时间
summary: 公司管理关系构成树，负责人通知直属下属耗时 informTime，求消息传到所有员工的总时间。
insight: 从 headID 沿管理树传播，孩子收到消息的时刻等于父亲收到时刻加父亲通知耗时；遍历过程中取最大到达时刻。
pitfalls: 使用的是父节点的 informTime
同一经理的下属并行收到消息
叶子通知时间通常为零

solutions.title: 管理树传播遍历
solutions.idea: 建立经理到下属邻接表并累计每个节点的到达时间。
steps: 由 manager 构造 children 列表
栈从 (headID,0) 开始，弹出后更新最大时间
每个 child 以 time+informTime[node] 入栈，返回最大值

code.java: class Solution { public int numOfMinutes(int n,int headID,int[] manager,int[] informTime){List<Integer>[] children=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)children[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int employee=0;employee<n;employee++)if(manager[employee]!=-1)children[manager[employee]].add(employee);Deque<int[]> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();stack.push(new int[]{headID,0});int answer=0;while(!stack.isEmpty()){int[] state=stack.pop();int node=state[0],time=state[1];answer=Math.max(answer,time);for(int child:children[node])stack.push(new int[]{child,time+informTime[node]});}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numOfMinutes(n:Int,headID:Int,manager:IntArray,informTime:IntArray):Int{val children=Array(n){mutableListOf<Int>()};for(employee in 0 until n)if(manager[employee]!=-1)children[manager[employee]].add(employee);val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();stack.push(intArrayOf(headID,0));var answer=0;while(stack.isNotEmpty()){val state=stack.pop();val node=state[0];val time=state[1];answer=maxOf(answer,time);for(child in children[node])stack.push(intArrayOf(child,time+informTime[node]))};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numOfMinutes(int n,int headID,vector<int>& manager,vector<int>& informTime){vector<vector<int>> children(n);for(int employee=0;employee<n;++employee)if(manager[employee]!=-1)children[manager[employee]].push_back(employee);stack<pair<int,int>> pending;pending.push({headID,0});int answer=0;while(!pending.empty()){auto [node,time]=pending.top();pending.pop();answer=max(answer,time);for(int child:children[node])pending.push({child,time+informTime[node]});}return answer;} };
